configuration: Personalized treatment prototype with user-configurable system-prompt preferences, retained chat context and both sensor reasoning loops

S->M.label: reported
S->M.rationale: User settings enter the system prompt; sensor summaries and recent user prompts persist between cycles.

M->A.label: reported
M->A.rationale: Preferences, chat history, and previous intervention summaries shape assistance and suppress repeated suggestions.

A->S.label: insufficient
A->S.rationale: Periodic acquisition is described, but no action-generated sensing request, interpretation guidance, or expected-effect check is specified.

M->S.label: reported
M->S.rationale: Retained session baselines interpret new physiological readings; past chat history also informs affect inference.

A->M.label: reported
A->M.rationale: Intervention occurrence enters summaries consumed by subsequent cycles.

record.label: stated
record.rationale: The service retains intervention occurrence for later notification decisions.
record.quote: Include whether the user was given an intervention or suggestion in the previous minute.

outcome.label: not_stated
outcome.rationale: Retention of observations as intervention outcomes is unspecified; questionnaires provide researcher evaluations.

attribution.label: not_stated
attribution.rationale: No service-side outcome-to-intervention checking is stated; repetition suppression alone does not establish attribution.

revision.label: not_stated
revision.rationale: User configuration and contextual adaptation do not establish service-authored changes to reusable mechanisms.

later_use.label: not_stated
later_use.rationale: No run under a service-revised mechanism is reported.

notes: Text-only treatment review. Memory includes within-session retention; permanent raw-sensor storage is not inferred.
